subject.title: fix: skip setup-only channel plugins in outbound resolution and drain pending deliveries on qqbot reconnect

question: Do the outbound and QQBot owners approve the operation-aware capability gates and QQBot reconnect retry selector as the canonical cross-plugin behavior?
rationale: The patch is technically sound and follows existing reconnect-recovery architecture, but it intentionally changes compatibility and queued-message retry semantics beyond the single reported QQBot scenario.

options.title: Approve and land
options.body: Accept the established shared-recovery pattern and operation-specific resolver after exact-head review by the outbound and QQBot owners.

options.title: Narrow retry bypass
options.body: Reduce the QQBot bypassBackoff error set if immediate retry for every gateway- or disconnected-labeled failure is not intended.

recommendation.title: Approve and land
recommendation.body: Accept the established shared-recovery pattern and operation-specific resolver after exact-head review by the outbound and QQBot owners.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history owns the QQBot lifecycle callback block and substantial portions of the central outbound delivery surface.
